guides.title: How to Apply for Learner Driving Licence (LLR) in Gujarat
guides.summary: Step-by-step procedure to apply for an Indian learner driving licence online via Sarathi Parivahan, take the computerised learner test, and obtain Form 2.
guides.department: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) & Gujarat Transport Dept

documents.name: Proof of Age (Aadhaar / Birth Certificate / 10th Marksheet)
documents.description: Official document proving applicant is at least 18 years old (16 for gearless 50cc).

documents.name: Proof of Address (Aadhaar / Electricity Bill / Voter ID)
documents.description: Must show current residential address matching Gujarat jurisdiction.
instructions: Address must match the selected RTO office

documents.name: Form 1 Self-Declaration as to Physical Fitness
documents.description: Self-declaration of medical fitness filled directly inside Sarathi online form.

documents.name: Form 1A Medical Certificate (if age > 40 or commercial transport)
documents.description: Signed and stamped certificate from a registered medical practitioner (MBBS).
instructions: Only required if applicant is over 40 years old or commercial transport

documents.name: Recent Passport Size Photograph & Signature
documents.description: Digital photo and scanned signature on plain white paper with dark ink.

steps.title: Submit Online Application on Sarathi Parivahan
steps.description: Visit sarathi.parivahan.gov.in, select Gujarat, and choose 'Apply for Learner Licence'. Authenticate using Aadhaar OTP.

steps.title: Upload Required Documents & Photo
steps.description: Upload age proof, address proof, and signature. Aadhaar eKYC automatically auto-fills photo and address.

steps.title: Pay Statutory Government Fees (₹200)
steps.description: Pay ₹150 for licence issuance and ₹50 for test fee using UPI, Net Banking, or Debit Card.

steps.title: Appear for Online Learner Test
steps.description: Take the 15-question multiple choice test on road traffic rules and signs from home or at RTO.

steps.title: Download Learner Licence (Form 2)
steps.description: Upon passing with 60% or higher, immediately download your digital learner licence PDF from Sarathi.

mistakes.title: Uploading Blurry Documents
mistakes.description: Unreadable scans will lead to application rejection by the RTO scrutinizer.

mistakes.title: Waiting Beyond 6 Months to Apply for Permanent DL
mistakes.description: A Learner Licence expires permanently after 180 days. You must apply for a permanent DL between day 30 and day 180.

faqs.question: Can I take the learner licence test from home in Gujarat?
faqs.answer: Yes, through Aadhaar-based authentication on Sarathi Parivahan, applicants in Gujarat can take the computerised exam from home with webcam proctoring.

faqs.question: What is the validity of a Learner Licence?
faqs.answer: A Learner Licence is valid for 6 months (180 days) across all states in India.

faqs.question: Can I drive alone on a learner licence?
faqs.answer: No. The Motor Vehicles Act requires an L-board on the vehicle and an instructor or permanent licence holder in the front passenger seat.

officialLinks.title: Sarathi Parivahan Gujarat Portal
officialLinks.description: Official MoRTH portal for application submission, fee payment, and test scheduling.

guides.title: How to Get a Permanent Driving Licence (DL) in Gujarat
guides.summary: Complete procedure to book an automated driving test track slot in Gujarat, pass the physical skill test, and receive your Smart Card Driving Licence.

documents.name: Valid Learner Licence (Form 2)
documents.description: Must have held LLR for at least 30 days and within 180 days.

documents.name: Form 5 Driving School Certificate (for transport vehicles)
documents.description: Training certificate from an accredited driving school.

documents.name: Vehicle Registration Certificate (RC) & Valid PUC
documents.description: RC of the test vehicle and pollution certificate.

documents.name: Valid Insurance Certificate of Test Vehicle
documents.description: Active motor insurance policy for test vehicle.

documents.name: Slot Booking Appointment Slip
documents.description: Printout of the Sarathi test appointment slip.

steps.title: Apply for New Driving Licence on Sarathi
steps.description: Fill Form 4 on sarathi.parivahan.gov.in referencing your active Learner Licence number.

steps.title: Book Automated Test Track Appointment
steps.description: Select date and time slot for Gujarat RTO automated driving test track.

steps.title: Pay Statutory Fees (₹500 for single class)
steps.description: Pay ₹300 test fee + ₹200 smart card fee online.

steps.title: Appear for Driving Skill Test at RTO
steps.description: Drive on sensor-monitored automated track (figure-8, reverse-S, up-gradient stop).

steps.title: Smart Card DL Delivery via Speed Post
steps.description: RTO dispatches your PVC Smart Card DL to your residential address via India Post.

mistakes.title: Arriving with Expired Vehicle PUC or Insurance
mistakes.description: The RTO track inspector inspects the test vehicle papers before allowing you on track.

faqs.question: Can I use my own car or bike for the RTO driving test?
faqs.answer: Yes, you must bring a roadworthy vehicle with valid RC, insurance, PUC, and an L-board.

faqs.question: How soon after getting LLR can I apply for permanent DL?
faqs.answer: You must wait at least 30 days after LLR issue date, and apply before day 180.

faqs.question: What if I fail the driving test in Gujarat?
faqs.answer: You can re-book a test appointment slot after 7 days by paying a ₹300 re-test fee.

mistakes.title: Discrepancy Between Old Passport Name and Aadhaar

faqs.question: How early before passport expiry can I apply for renewal?
faqs.answer: You can apply up to 1 year (12 months) before your current passport expires.

faqs.question: Is police verification required for every renewal?
faqs.answer: If your address and personal particulars are unchanged, police verification may be post-dispatch or waived under MEA guidelines.

faqs.question: Can I renew an Indian passport under Tatkaal in Gujarat?
faqs.answer: Yes, Tatkaal processing is available at PSK Ahmedabad, Surat, Rajkot, and Vadodara with ₹2,000 extra fee.

guides.title: How to Apply for New PAN Card (Instant e-PAN & PVC) in Gujarat
guides.summary: Obtain an Indian Permanent Account Number (PAN) through Instant Paperless e-KYC on the Income Tax Portal in under 10 minutes or order a physical PVC card for ₹50.
guides.department: Income Tax Department, Ministry of Finance & Protean / NSDL

documents.name: Aadhaar Card with linked active mobile number
documents.description: Sole document required for instant OTP paperless e-KYC.

steps.title: Visit Income Tax e-Filing Portal
steps.description: Go to incometax.gov.in and click 'Instant e-PAN'.

steps.title: Enter 12-digit Aadhaar Number
steps.description: Input Aadhaar and confirm consent for demographic authentication.

steps.title: Authenticate with Aadhaar OTP
steps.description: Enter 6-digit OTP received on UIDAI registered mobile.

steps.title: Instant e-PAN Allotment & PDF Download
steps.description: Digitally signed e-PAN PDF is generated within 10 minutes for free.

steps.title: Order Physical PVC Card (Optional)
steps.description: Visit Protean or UTIITSL reprint portal to request physical card delivery for ₹50.

mistakes.title: Applying with Mobile Not Linked to Aadhaar
mistakes.description: Instant e-PAN strictly requires an active mobile linked to UIDAI to receive the OTP.

faqs.question: Is digital e-PAN legally valid for banking and government work?
faqs.answer: Yes, CBDT Rule 114 clearly states that digitally signed e-PAN is 100% legally equivalent to physical PVC PAN.

faqs.question: What is the fee for Instant e-PAN?
faqs.answer: Instant e-PAN on the Income Tax Department portal is completely free of charge (₹0).

faqs.question: Can minors apply for instant e-PAN?
faqs.answer: No. Instant e-PAN via Aadhaar e-KYC is restricted to adult citizens (18+). Minors must apply via Form 49A with parent signature.

faqs.question: Is there any statutory fee for Voter ID registration in India?

faqs.question: Can 17-year-olds apply in advance?
faqs.answer: Yes, ECI permits citizens who have turned 17 to submit advance applications.

faqs.question: What is the official portal for Gujarat voter services?
faqs.answer: Official services are at voters.eci.gov.in and ceo.gujarat.gov.in.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for priority NFSA card in Gujarat?

faqs.question: What is the validity of Gujarat Domicile Certificate?

faqs.question: Can I use school marksheets as stay proof?
